# periodic_gaussian_filter { #mofography.helper.periodic_gaussian_filter }

```python
helper.periodic_gaussian_filter(arr, sigma)
```

Apply a periodic (wrap-around) Gaussian filter using np.roll.

Parameters:
- arr: input ndarray (1D, 2D, or 3D)
- sigma: standard deviation of Gaussian

Returns:
- Smoothed ndarray with same shape
